# Preserved failed copy-composition inference

29 October2026. The initial Section2 ended with this incorrect extension:

    delta_source may be the strong (2) if the source itself was initialized
    by an arbitrary future-selected sparse pattern. Thus the ENTIRE copied
    error pattern, rather than only its decoded bit, can meet the restart
    premise.

C's substantive whole read caught the missing premise. A source pattern
selected using the entire future can consult the destination's future
sampling coins. Its bounded wrong density does not justify the destination
Markov-generator/excursion calculation. Uniform source retention alone
does not restore that adaptation. The naive finite union over source
patterns overwhelms the copy exponent at the displayed densities.

The fixed-source copy remains qualified only for the original independent
source initialization. Its cleaner destination threshold, exact scalar
drift and finite constants remain valid under that premise. The simultaneous
all-pattern RESTORING-register theorem and the fixed-catalogue Palm bound
are separate surviving results; C reconstructed them as written. No recursive
future-initialized copy/handshake theorem is claimed. Both scalar execution
receipts are finite arithmetic diagnostics and do not settle this quantifier.

The protocol researcher is pursuing a pathwise FIFO workload representation
which can avoid this initial-state dependence entirely. It is not declared
successful by this correction note.
